## [1.7.0](https://github.com/Nagol12344/patch/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0) (2026-09-24)

### ✨ New Features

* **fix:** totally how these commit messages should work ([9cb03db](https://github.com/Nagol12344/patch/commit/9cb03db5c25f14e5cac12221065885d46e94cf00))

patches.name: Allow landscape orientation
patches.description: Removes Better Place's portrait orientation lock so the app can rotate to landscape.

patches.name: Fix file picker camera prompt
patches.description: Strips the capture attribute and forces the native chooser to use gallery-only file inputs.

patches.name: Inject Charity Framework
patches.description: Embeds and runs the Charity Framework plugin loader on bplace.art pages (mobile GM shim + native fetch bridge).

patches.name: Remove unnecessary camera permission request
patches.description: Prevents the file picker from requesting CAMERA permission or forcing camera capture.
